scope: AgentDojo stock synthetic clean-only; no attacks, no model fitting, no real endpoints
task_model_contract: Retain all 20 v37 tasks and its entire model configuration, base prompt and function-tags template. Never remove a task after outcomes. No tokenizer/model/prompt/max-token changes.

arms.syntax: strict first; explicit whole-message serialization recovery with runtime argument validation
arms.syntax_retry: syntax plus the unchanged first-turn tool-intent heuristic and one correction generation

v38.budget: one read-only replay of all assistant messages in 60 existing traces; no calls or generations
v38.interpretation: Implementation viability only, not a clean-utility effect or fresh confirmation. Known historical outcomes must not be used to tune the grammar after replay.

v39.selection: Choose syntax if it passes; otherwise syntax_retry if it passes; otherwise NO_GO. No tuning or resubmission.

v40.arms: strict and the unique frozen v39 passing selection

integrity: all frozen episode keys and raw traces complete
zero runtime failures and attempted Python network calls
actual task-level seed shared across arms
identical first input token arrays and first completions across arms per task/seed
at most one extra retry generation in syntax_retry
all control and candidate tasks retained
seed_allocation: run_seed * 10000 + frozen v37 task index * 100; independent of arm; rotate arm execution order by task and seed index
metrics: task-level exact one-sided paired sign-flip test
generation calls and output tokens including retry cost
statistics: Inferential units are 20 tasks, not 60 independent Bernoulli episodes. V39 applies p<=0.025 for two comparisons; v40 is independent-seed, same-task confirmation with p<=0.05. This does not establish unseen-task generalization.
stop_policy: At any invalid or NO_GO stage, retain evidence and stop downstream stages without retries or relaxing thresholds. End automation after v40 conclusion. A clean GO does not authorize attacks or large world-model training in this cycle.
